A vendor can overwrite or sync inventory against a competitor's catalog.

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException, status
import pandas as pd
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/marketplace/catalogs")

@router.post("/{catalog_id}/sync-stock")
async def sync_catalog_inventory(
    catalog_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    catalog_repo: CatalogRepository = Depends(get_catalog_repo),
    user: VendorUser = Depends(get_current_vendor)
):
    catalog_meta = await catalog_repo.get_catalog(catalog_id)
    if not catalog_meta:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Catalog not found")

    if catalog_meta.vendor_id != user.vendor_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Cannot sync inventory for a catalog owned by another vendor")

    file_content = await file.read()
    uploaded_df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(file_content))

    master_catalog_df = pd.read_csv("/data/marketplace/catalogs_index.csv")
    matched_catalog = master_catalog_df[master_catalog_df["catalog_id"] == catalog_id]

    merged = pd.merge(uploaded_df, matched_catalog, on="sku", how="inner")
    updated_items = merged[["sku", "stock_qty", "unit_price"]].to_dict(orient="records")

    return {"catalog_id": catalog_id, "updated_count": len(updated_items), "items": updated_items}
